_about: Copy to <TREND_DATA_DIR>/watchlist.json. universe_id is the key; root_place_id is kept for identity checks; label is a mutable display name, never a key. event_windows mark known in-game events (UTC) so off-event troughs exclude them.

outside._about: Fixed outside panels. apple: countries (2-letter), feeds top-free/top-paid, limit 10/25/50. steam: app ids. youtube: channel ids (uploads playlist), video ids, optional queries {q, days, max_results, regionCode, relevanceLanguage}; searches are capped by collector.youtube_search_daily_budget.
